Test: A price quoted more than 15 minutes ago is refused (BR-6)
Steps:
1. cd aws/lambda
2. npm test
3. Find the line "validateOrder: quote 15 minutes and 1 ms old" (tests/trades.test.js)
Input:
Stock AAPL · Buy · Shares 1 · Order type Market
Price quote: AAPL $185.50, quoted 15 minutes and 1 ms (900,001 ms) before the order (the test fixes the clock and passes this quote to validateOrder)
Account: not used; the price check runs before the cash and shares checks
Expected result: Order refused: success false, reason "Price unavailable."
Actual result: success false, reason "Price unavailable." (npm test on 2026-11-27: 80 of 80 tests passed)
Result: Pass (automated unit test: validateOrder: quote 15 minutes and 1 ms old)
Notes: Not run on the live site: its prices are simulated and always quoted at the moment of the order (aws/lambda/backend/market-data.js), so a stale price cannot happen there. The companion test "validateOrder: quote exactly 15 minutes old" checks that a price exactly 15 minutes old is still accepted; it also passed.
